description: Unsigned transaction liquidating a position past its limit, through the market's own liquidator (anyone may call it, and it pays the caller): no money of the wallet's, Morpho hands over the collateral, it is sold, the debt repaid, and the rest goes to the wallet. market: a stock's symbol with side short or usdg, an agent credit market's symbol (as credit_markets lists them), or a market id (0x and 64 hex) for a coin short or a coin loan (a coin's address with side works too; keeper_jobs gives the arguments). Reads the position fresh from the chain, sizes it as Borro's keeper does, simulates it from the wallet, and sets minProfit to 90% of the simulated profit unless min_profit_usdg is given: under it the transaction reverts and costs the gas alone. Refused in words when the position is healthy, the profit is under min_profit_usdg, the stock vault has lent its stock out (CannotRedeem), or the market is not Borro's.

borrower.description: The position's owner on Morpho (for a stock short, the shorter's wallet or its BorroShort account)

kind.description: Optional, as /jobs.json's prepare gives it: checked against the market

market.description: A stock's symbol (like "NVDA", with side), an agent credit market's symbol, a market id (0x and 64 hex), or a coin's address (with side)

min_profit_usdg.description: The least USDG the wallet will take; less and it reverts (default 90% of the simulated profit)

side.description: For a stock or a coin given by its address: short (it is borrowed) or usdg (USDG borrowed against it)

wallet.description: The wallet that sends it and is paid

name: liquidate
title: Prepare: liquidate a position
